lines: Come in. My house is yours.
I am grateful for the invitation.
There you are! I have been waiting. Here, a jug for the road!
That is a warm welcome. Thank you.
You came! Sit, sit, take the weight off your feet!
At last! Here is a jug of ale. Your health!
This is a fine thing. Thank you.
At last! I have counted the days!
Hello! My, what a fine house!
Come in, come in! It is so good that you came!
Thank you for coming all this way! Stay as long as you like; you will be my honoured guest.
Kind words from a kind host. Thank you.
Oh, it is you! How good that you found the time.
The pleasure is on my side. A kind welcome, this.
It feels like coming home. This is good.
Good! Sit down and rest your feet.
Many thanks. I owe you one.
Good! You got here with all your limbs, I see.
And to you! What news from the road? Shed that armour and sit by the fire.
Thank you. Just what I needed.
Greetings! It is an honour to have you under my roof!
You are too kind. I am flattered.
Nobody handles a sabre the way you do!
They say you are a learned man.
Ha! I have read a book or two in my time.
I was told your battle plans could beat the devil himself!
No, no, you praise me too much. I am only a man.
The whole land speaks of your good heart!
Well, I have been lucky to be born on the right side of things.
A good question. I am glad you asked it.
People call you the wisest head in the regiment.
Thank you. That is kind of you to say.
I hear your tactics are out of the ordinary.
A tactic is only clever after it has won, my friend.
I want to fight for the plain folk of the Hetmanate.
That is a generous heart you have.
